located_point.method: Excavators' site coordinate, 29 deg 02' 22" N, 76 deg 18' 21" E (Shinde et al. 2008, chapter II, printed p. 4, as recorded in sites-located-v1.json); Datum Point 2 is given as 29 deg 02' 26" N, 76 deg 18' 30" E on Fig. 3.1 of the 2011 report. The levelled site is under fields and could not be delimited in the Sentinel-2 composite, so the published coordinate is kept.

sources.result: No line measured. The site was levelled for agriculture (report p. 21) and the composite shows only fields and field boundaries around the published coordinate; the excavated mud-brick houses, 0.4-1 m walls in backfilled trenches, are far below the 10 m resolution.

notes: Imagery: not measurable. Plans: five drawings of the 2006-08 excavations, all referred to the excavation grid, which the report describes as laid out in cardinal directions (true or magnetic unstated). In the Central Area (Locality 1) the house blocks, Main Street and Lane no. 1 lie at theta -18.4 to -23.2 degrees on the 2011 Fig. 5.68 (main system -21.6) and -19.9 to -25.8 on the 2008 Fig. 19 (main system -22.2). The long wall closing the Central Courtyard on the south and the east wall of room 3I are turned about 6 degrees less (theta -14.7 to -17.3) on both plans and form a second system. Trench 3A3 in Locality 3 has the same direction as the Central Area (-20.4 and -21.4), Structure no. 1 in Trench 2 (North Area) is turned slightly further (-24.0 to -28.9), and the house walls in Trench 3X (Locality 3, northwest area) lie within 3 degrees of the grid (-2.6 to +1.0). The town therefore has one dominant direction about 21-22 degrees anticlockwise of grid north, with one house group in Trench 3X built on the cardinal directions. All five sources are drawings by the same excavation team on the same grid, so they are not independent of each other in their north reference.
plan_search: Plan library entries farmana-01 to farmana-04 (2008 report) and the held 2011 final report, whose Figs. 3.1, 3.2 and 5.68 supply the grid definition and the Central Area plan. The 2011 report's structure-detail figures were not measured.
stated_orientation_encounters: Numerical orientations of the Farmana structures appear in the report texts and were met before or while measuring: the 2011 report, PDF p. 111 (printed p. 97), text above Fig. 5.68, on Structure Complex No. 2; the 2008 report, PDF p. 34 (printed p. 22), on Structure Complex No. 1, and PDF p. 36 (printed p. 24), on the town as a whole (both read in a page thumbnail); the 2008 report, PDF p. 28 (printed p. 16), describes Trench 3X walls as running north-south. None of these statements was used; every value here comes from lines fitted on the plans against the drawn north reference.
